AiSearch.description_en: Describes how to invoke the multi-stage streaming API V3 for general search by using the Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI SDK and provides parameter descriptions
AiSearch.description_zh: 本文介绍通过阿里云OpenAPI SDK调用通用搜索多阶段流式接口V3的方法以及参数说明

GenericAdvancedSearch.description_en: This topic describes how to call the GenericAdvancedSearch operation by using Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI SDKs and provides parameter descriptions. Compared with GenericSearch, GenericAdvancedSearch provides better recall from authoritative websites and returns up to 40 results, delivering more authoritative and diverse data. The response parameters and format of the enhanced operation are the same as those of GenericAdvancedSearch
GenericAdvancedSearch.description_zh: 本文介绍通过阿里云OpenAPI SDK调用通用增强搜索接口（GenericAdvancedSearch）的方法以及参数说明。GenericAdvancedSearch相较于GenericSearch提供了更好的权威站点的召回，召回数量最大可以达到40条，可以提供更好的权威性与多样性数据。增强版接口返回参数字段与格式与GenericAdvancedSearch一致

GetIqsUsage.description_en: Queries the daily usage of the information query service API
GetIqsUsage.description_zh: 信息查询服务接口日维度使用量查询

GlobalSearch.description_en: Searches for global information by using the Global Edition search
GlobalSearch.description_zh: 通晓搜索-出海版(全球信息搜索)

OmniAnswer.description_en: This topic describes the SearchStream streaming API for intelligent search and AI chat. Based on retrieval augmented generation (RAG) and large language models, this API accepts natural language questions from users and can automatically execute intent recognition, query rewrite, and content generation, and retrieve data from multiple sources. The API uses the Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming protocol to return data, supporting real-time output of the infer status, reference sources, and token-by-token generated answers. This API is suitable for AI chat and search scenarios that require low latency and high interpretability
OmniAnswer.description_zh: 本文档介绍智能搜索问答流式接口（SearchStream）。该接口基于检索增强生成（RAG）与大语言模型技术，接收用户自然语言问题后，自动执行意图识别、查询改写、多源检索与内容生成。接口采用 Server-Sent Events (SSE) 流式协议返回数据，支持实时输出推理状态、参考来源及逐字生成的答案，适用于对低延迟、高可解释性有要求的智能问答与搜索场景

ReadPageBasic.description_en: Retrieves HTML and parses static web page content
ReadPageBasic.description_zh: 快速获取 HTML 并解析静态网页内容

ReadPageScrape.description_en: Reads HTML and parses web page content in a browser sandbox environment. The operation starts parsing after the resources on the target page are fully loaded. You can adjust the maximum wait time by using the pageTimeout parameter. The overall execution duration is significantly affected by the resource loading status of the target site
ReadPageScrape.description_zh:
通过浏览器沙箱环境读取 HTML 并解析网页内容。
接口将在目标页面资源完全加载后开始解析（可通过 pageTimeout 参数调整最大等待时长），接口整体耗时将显著受目标站点资源加载情况的影响

UnifiedSearch.description_en: Provides the Tongxiao unified search API to quickly and easily integrate web-wide general search capabilities
UnifiedSearch.description_zh: 通晓统一搜索API，简单快捷的接入全网通用搜索能力
